card.name: Adjectives before an expected noun
card.fires_on: Modifier words like public, illicit, private, indigenous or free that come right before a noun in general web or academic text. Also fires on punctuation or spaces before a number or title.

modes.label: Adjective before noun
modes.description: An adjective such as public, illicit, private or indigenous that sits just before a noun like activities, sector or dancing.
modes.example: drug trafficking and other<< illicit>> activities.

modes.label: Spaces or colons before numbers/titles
modes.description: A colon or space just before a number or subtitle.
modes.example: Charles C. Mann’s twin volumes, 1491<<:>> New Revelations of the Americas Before Columbus

card.writes: It suppresses a push toward the word practice, so it lowers that word after modifiers.
card.plain: It fires on a describing word like public or private, where the next word is a noun and not the word practice.
